SoftFloat Release 2a (68K-specialized, from Hatari) — MX68K vendored copy
(This file is MX68K作成 — not an upstream file.)

Source:     https://github.com/hatari/hatari, directory src/cpu/softfloat/
Commit:     b166d8c8319da5418490d556ad40706c0995b6f8
            Verified with:
              gh api repos/hatari/hatari/commits/b166d8c8319da5418490d556ad40706c0995b6f8 --jq .sha
Lineage:    softfloat.c / softfloat.h / softfloat-macros.h / softfloat-specialize.h:
              SoftFloat Release 2a (John R. Hauser) -> QEMU (relicensed back to 2a in 2015;
              Fabrice Bellard's BSD portions, GPLv2+ portions) -> Previous / Hatari (SOFTFLOAT_68K).
            softfloat_fpsp.c / softfloat_fpsp_tables.h (transcendental functions, MC68881/68882):
              Motorola M68040 FPSP -> NetBSD sys/arch/m68k/fpsp/ (1994) -> Previous
              (Andreas Grabher) -> Hatari.
License:    softfloat.c and the three headers: SoftFloat-2a + BSD (Fabrice Bellard) + GPL-2.0-or-later,
            as stated in each file's own header (kept unmodified). Full 2a text: LICENSES/SoftFloat-2a.txt.
            softfloat_fpsp.c / softfloat_fpsp_tables.h: no notice of their own upstream (Previous is
            GPL-2.0-or-later as a whole). They are derived from the Motorola M68040 FPSP, whose notice
            requires that "this entire notice is retained without alteration" and that modified versions
            are identified as such; MX68K restores that notice at the top of both files.
            Full text: LICENSES/Motorola-M68040-FPSP.txt. See NOTICE-THIRD-PARTY.md for open questions.
Re-vendor:  bash Scripts/vendor_softfloat_2a.sh (fetches the 6 files at the pinned commit, checks each
            against a hardcoded SHA256, fails if any contains SoftFloat 2b's "INDEMNIFY" wording, copies
            4 files unmodified, prepends the MX68K comment block to the 2 FPSP files and checks that the
            remainder is byte-identical to upstream, and checks that the MX68K-authored files exist).

    reproduces the Motorola notice in full. Everything after the block is byte-identical to upstream.
  MX68K-authored (2):
    softfloat/softfloat.h   1-line forwarding shim (#include "../softfloat.h"). Upstream softfloat.c
                            includes "softfloat/softfloat.h" (Hatari resolves it with -I src/cpu);
                            this shim lets it resolve relative to softfloat.c's own directory.
    MX68K_VENDOR.txt        this file.

Excluded (not vendored) and why:
  - softfloat_decimal.c: packed-decimal conversion; depends on Hatari's sysconfig.h/sysdeps.h/
    write_log and carries no notice. (P897: FMOVE.P is left unsupported for now instead.)
  - Hatari fpp.c / fpp_softfloat.c / fpp.h (UAE FPU decoder): deeply tied to newcpu.h/regs/currprefs.
  - Any SoftFloat Release 2b code (indemnification clause). Musashi's upstream softfloat/ (2b) remains
    excluded from ThirdParty/Musashi/ as before.

Status:
  Called from ThirdParty/Musashi/m68kfpu.c (P897: MX68K-authored port of MAME m68kfpu.cpp), which
  implements MC68881/68882 instructions for the X68030 (EC030) Musashi core. The FPU is enabled only
  with the environment variable MX68K_MUSASHI_FPU=1 (MX68K_MUSASHI_FPU_MODEL=68881|68882, default
  68882); otherwise FPU instructions still take the line-1111 exception as before.
  Not used: floatdecimal_to_floatx80 / floatx80_to_floatdecimal (declared in softfloat.h, defined in
  the non-vendored softfloat_decimal.c — calling them would fail to link; FMOVE.P is unsupported).
  Host-side check: bash Scripts/softfloat_2a_selftest.sh; FPU instruction check: bash
  Scripts/musashi_selftest.sh (links softfloat.c / softfloat_fpsp.c since P897).

Build notes (MX68K):
  - softfloat.c and softfloat_fpsp.c are compiled into both targets (MX68K and MX68K-iOS),
    COMPILER_FLAGS = -w (upstream warnings). No .h file from here is added to the Xcode project.
  - ThirdParty/softfloat_2a is NOT in HEADER_SEARCH_PATHS: ThirdParty/Musashi/softfloat/softfloat.h
    has the same name (since P897 an MX68K forwarding shim to this directory's softfloat.h), so
    headers here are reached only by quoted includes relative to the including file's own directory.
    Callers outside this directory must include by relative path, as with Musashi.
  - softfloat.h defines SOFTFLOAT_68K itself (line 1), so both .c files see the same configuration.
